new.title: New peko
new.seedTooBig: A seed is at most 64 KB.
new.seedInvalid: This doesn't look like a seed: it has no `name`.
new.noModel: A peko needs a model to think with. Add one in Settings → Models first.
new.nameTaken: You already have a peko with this name.
new.seedHint: Seeds from PekoHub give your peko its definition; it still gets a new identity, and you own it.
new.waking: Waking up {{name}}… this can take a minute
new.setupTitle: This seed asks {{name}} to set these up
new.setupWarning: On its first turn it will run commands and download code on this computer, as you. Read each step before you agree.

usage.title: Usage · {{period}}
usage.over: Over budget — your peko won't call its model again until the budget resets or you raise it.
usage.unpriced: Spend counts once the peko's model has a price (Settings → Models → Edit).

import.title: Import a .peko package
import.intro: A .peko package wakes the same peko — its identity, memory, and private keys travel with the package. To grow a fresh peko from a definition instead, create one from its seed.
import.imported: Package imported — the peko is in your sidebar.
import.rotate: Import as a new peko with a fresh identity (needed when this peko already lives on this computer).
import.runsCode: This package can run code on this computer:

addRemote.title: Add a peko
addRemote.intro: Type the ID of someone's public peko, like @alice/coding-assistant, or paste its link from PekoHub.
addRemote.label: Peko ID or link
addRemote.invalid: That doesn't look like a peko's ID or link. Expected @owner/name or https://pekohub.ai/@owner/name.
addRemote.inviteToken: Invite token detected — the peko's owner shared this link privately with you.

remote.gone: This peko is no longer in your list.
remote.ownElsewhere: One of your pekos on another computer. It's in your list while it's on PekoHub; to take it off, remove it or make it local only on that computer.
remote.removeConfirm: Remove {{name}} from your list? You can connect again with its share link.

private.label: Private
private.hint: On PekoHub; only its contacts can reach it

profile.inviteHint: Share with one friend. Burns immediately on revoke.
profile.exportWarning: The package contains this peko's private keys — its full existence. Treat it like a password: anyone holding it can wake and impersonate this peko.
profile.removeConfirm: Remove {{name}}? This deletes its workspace, memory, and conversations. It cannot be undone.
profile.removeHint: Delete this peko and everything it knows.
profile.noModels: No configured models. Add one in Settings → Models first.
profile.exposureConflict: This peko is already registered from another computer — a peko can be online in only one place.

setup.title: {{name}} is setting itself up
setup.stopHint: It stops after the step it is on and keeps what it has done.
setup.empty: Nothing yet. Steps appear here as it works.
setup.titleSteps: {{name}} is going through its setup steps
